first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and the archived evidence most directly supports testing a shorter onboarding flow. A small guarded test can assess whether improved time-to-value restores activation without sacrificing downstream qualified revenue or account quality. Promotional pricing addresses competitive pressure but may trade sustainable revenue for short-term acquisition.

mid.rationale: Run a standard experiment on a shorter onboarding flow. The verified source shows completion improved 13%, time-to-value fell by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention rose 3%, directly addressing the current onboarding decline while supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Activation messaging also has strong evidence, but onboarding simplification offers the larger downstream retention gain and may improve both completion and activation. Monitor activation, qualification, conversion quality, and retention rather than optimizing completion alone.

final2.rationale: The competitor’s deeper cut and doubled churn conversations make targeted promotional pricing the most immediate response for price-sensitive SMB accounts. Use a tightly segmented, time-limited offer rather than broad discounting, with guardrails on margin, qualified revenue, retention, and cannibalization. The evidence is inherited but unverified this cycle, so keep the test small and preserve uncertainty.
